campaign.post_title: Refresh a Better Life — 《刷新美好生活》 (2026)
campaign.post_content:
Refresh a Better Life — 《刷新美好生活》 is ORBI's nationwide children, family & professional drawing campaign for 2026, jointly executed with Creative Wings (Yibon Mag Enterprise). Theme: 从一刷开始 · 从小习惯，改变世界 — Start with one brush, small habits change the world.

How it works

  1. Pick your category — Primary (7–12), Secondary A (13–15), Secondary B (16–18), or Open (18+).
  2. Upload your artwork PNG at the required dimensions.
  3. At checkout, pick your favourite ORBI toothbrush casing colour — you'll see a live preview of your design printed on the casing.
  4. Pay the RM 15 entry fee and submit. You'll receive an e-Certificate once registration is complete.
  5. Every participant receives an ORBI Personalised Toothbrush Set with their own artwork printed on the product (provided by ORBI).

Categories & Prizes

RM 3,500 total prize pool across 12 winners (3 per category). Cash prizes & toothbrush sets fully sponsored by ORBI; Yibon issues every participant's e-Certificate.

  • Primary / Secondary A / Secondary B — Champion RM 400 · 1st Runner-Up RM 200 · 2nd Runner-Up RM 100
  • Open Category (Professional) — Champion RM 800 · 1st Runner-Up RM 400 · 2nd Runner-Up RM 200

Judging criteria (out of 100)

  1. Creativity & Originality
  2. Relevance to Theme — 《刷新美好生活》
  3. Technical Execution
  4. Emotional Impact

Submission target: 500 artworks · Prize Presentation at the physical exhibition (date TBC, joint announcement with ORBI). Top artworks will be displayed at the curated exhibition (50–80 pieces). All other participants still receive their printed toothbrush set and digital certificate.

Organiser: ORBI (One Morning Sdn Bhd) · Campaign Manager: Yibon Mag Enterprise — Creative Wings · creativewings.asia

campaign.cw_judging_criteria:
Each artwork is scored out of 100 across four criteria by a panel of at least three judges. Aggregated average score determines ranking within each category.

  1. Creativity & Originality — how fresh and inventive the idea is.
  2. Relevance to Theme — how well the artwork expresses 《刷新美好生活》— Refresh a Better Life and the message of small daily habits.
  3. Technical Execution — composition, line work, colour, finish.
  4. Emotional Impact — does it move the viewer / leave an impression.

Top 3 per category become winners; the next ~50–80 high-scorers are curated for the physical exhibition.

faq.question: Who can join Refresh a Better Life?
faq.answer: Anyone aged 7 and above, in one of four categories: Primary (7–12), Secondary A (13–15), Secondary B (16–18), or Open / Professional (18+). Participants 17 and under should have a guardian complete the registration.

faq.question: How much is the entry fee?
faq.answer: RM 15.00 per submission across all four categories. The fee covers your printed ORBI toothbrush set, digital e-Certificate, and the chance to win cash prizes.

faq.question: What dimensions must my artwork be?
faq.answer: Your artwork must be a PNG file at exactly the dimensions shown on the upload form (the form will reject other sizes automatically). The fixed size makes sure your design lines up pixel-perfect on the toothbrush casing in the live preview at checkout.

faq.question: What if I have a vector source file (.ai / .pdf / .svg)?
faq.answer: You can optionally upload it alongside your PNG. The printer will use it for the highest-quality reproduction. The PNG is what's used for the live mockup preview and is sufficient on its own — the source file is a bonus.

faq.question: How do I pick my toothbrush casing colour?
faq.answer: On the checkout page you'll see swatches for every available ORBI casing colour with a live mockup canvas. Click any swatch and the preview re-paints with your design composited onto that casing. Your final choice is recorded with your order.

faq.question: What do winners receive?
faq.answer: Cash prizes (RM 100 to RM 800 depending on category and rank) plus the same ORBI personalised toothbrush set every participant gets. All cash prizes are fully sponsored by ORBI.

faq.question: When and where is the exhibition?
faq.answer: A physical exhibition + prize presentation ceremony is planned after judging concludes. Exact date and venue will be announced jointly with ORBI once confirmed. ~50–80 shortlisted artworks will be on display.

faq.question: Can I submit more than one artwork?
faq.answer: Yes — you may submit up to 5 artworks in total across the campaign. Each submission is a separate RM 15 entry. Each must be a complete, original work.
